message.content:
This editorial illustration features five caricatured human figures in an indoor setting. In the foreground, three men are positioned around a kitchen sink. On the left, a man with a beard and light-colored shirt leans toward the sink. On the right, a man with glasses and a white collared shirt stands behind a man wearing a dark cap and green jacket. This third man is shown from the back, looking toward the window. Between them is a metallic double-basin sink with a curved faucet, set into a wooden-look countertop.

Through a large window above the sink, two other men are visible outdoors. One man in a light blue collared shirt points a finger toward the interior while resting his other hand on the shoulder of a smaller man beside him.

Large red text reads "TEMPO" across the top. Smaller white text at the bottom right reads "AGUS HILANG IMIN TERBILANG," followed by a paragraph mentioning names and a question mark. Black text at the top mentions "Kendaraan Listrik" and "Bursa Karbon." A barcode and pricing information are in the bottom-left corner.
